taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: MySQL effective account/host matching and stored-object privileges
controls.source_trace: Resolve the actual authenticated account and effective active roles before following a stored routine/view into protected tables.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve the matched user@host account, active roles and direct grants before invoking stored-object authority. SQL SECURITY DEFINER may deliberately delegate a narrow operation; inspect definer identity, object body and caller-controlled arguments only when that path is reachable. A client-supplied username alone does not identify the effective server account.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated database with two owned users and synthetic rows; compare intended access and a controlled definer-object invocation.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A broad grant on a different host account or inactive role is not effective access for the tested connection.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain matched account and stored-object authority, testing normal routines and restricted table operations.
